# Run ledger — P24.4 (CI.1 / GL-CI-01) — CI composed hardening

- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/P24.4__ci-composed-hardening.md`
- **Base:** `devin/p24-3-observability-alerting` @ `a2c6711` · **Branch:** `devin/p24-4-ci-hardening`
- **Config:** implement-spec autonomous=true `live_verification=false`; tests/gap/self-review/evidence on.
- **Gate:** none. **Live stage:** offline-only.
- **CI honesty note (per ticket):** an isolated worker cannot execute GitHub Actions.
  "CI runs X green" therefore means: the workflow is correctly defined **and** the identical
  commands run green locally (Docker daemon up, Node + `web/node_modules` present). The
  first on-runner execution is tracked as `D-CI.1-1` — never fabricated.

## Requirements to satisfy and stamp
- **GL-CI-01** — a CI job that runs the composed `tests/e2e` for real (Node + Docker
  present → S8/LD-V08 web build runs in CI, closing the P20.4 gap honestly); a nightly
  composed run; dependency / license / secret scanning (free-tier/zero-cost, D4 — no
  credential literals); `make docs-check` + `check-build-memory.sh` enforced on PRs.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] CI runs `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1` composed suite green with the web build present *(deterministic)*
- [ ] a seeded secret/license violation fails CI *(deterministic)*
- [ ] the nightly run reports *(deterministic)*
- [ ] `make docs-check` + `check-build-memory.sh` enforced on PRs *(deterministic)*
- [ ] universal phase-gate (tests for every new behaviour; ids stamped; ADR/RISK; BUILD_INDEX + LEDGER)

## Plan
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — add a `composed` job (checkout → uv → `make sync` → Node 22 +
  `npm --prefix web ci` → `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 uv run pytest tests/e2e`, Ryuk off);
  add a `security` job (offline secret + licence scans on PR/push); add an explicit
  `check-build-memory.sh` step to the `docs` job (already inside `make docs-check`;
  made visible per the contract's wording).
- `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` — nightly cron (03:00 UTC) + `workflow_dispatch`:
  composed e2e (JUnit artifact) + all three scans + a `nightly-report.md` uploaded
  `if: always()`; the job exits non-zero if any stage failed (report is most useful on red).
- `scripts/ci/secret_scan.py` — stdlib tracked-file scanner (AKIA/gh*/xox*/sk-/AIza/PEM
  shapes; superset of the check-build-memory grep set). Exit 1 on findings.
- `scripts/ci/license_scan.py` — stdlib licence classifier over `importlib.metadata`
  (mirrors `web/scripts/check-licenses.mjs` DENY categories: -NC/noncommercial/BUSL/SSPL/
  Elastic/Commons-Clause/proprietary; unresolvable licence = review-required failure;
  strong-copyleft (GPL/AGPL) frozen-expected-set diff = failure). `--records-json` for
  deterministic replay in tests.
- `scripts/ci/dep_audit.sh` — `uv export` → `uvx pip-audit` (network; nightly only —
  advisories drift independent of commits).
- `Makefile` — `security-scan` = `scan-secrets` + `scan-licenses` + `audit-deps`
  (humans and CI run the same commands).
- `tests/unit/test_ci_workflows.py` — workflow-shape tests (fail if a job/step is removed).
- `tests/unit/test_security_scanners.py` — seeded-violation tests (the scanners must catch
  a planted secret / excluded licence / unexpected copyleft; fail-if-removed).
- **Security fix surfaced by the new gate:** `pip-audit` on the locked tree reports
  starlette 0.48.0 vulnerable (PYSEC-2026-248/249/1942/2280/2281; fixed ≥1.3.1 —
  the 0.x line never received fixes). `api/pyproject.toml` bumps `fastapi>=0.141,<0.142`
  (0.135+ permits starlette 1.x) and pins `starlette>=1.3.1` explicitly; `uv lock` +
  `make export` regenerated; full suite re-verified.
- `docs/adr/ADR-078` — owned decisions (scanner choice, PR-vs-nightly split, nightly cadence,
  composed-job structure); RISK-P24-03; Appendix F row + regenerated index + spec rebuild.

- `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflows.py tests/unit/test_security_scanners.py`
  → 24 passed.
- `uv run python scripts/ci/secret_scan.py` → `clean — 1639 file(s), 0 credential shapes`.
- Seeded demo: `AWS_KEY = "AKIA…EXAMPLE"` (the canonical AWS docs example key) in a
  tracked-tree file → exit 1 naming
  `seeded_leak.py:1: aws-access-key` (the key itself never printed); file removed.
- `uv run python scripts/ci/license_scan.py` → `119 dists — 116 ok, 3 flagged (expected
  docutils/igraph/rfc3987), 0 denied, 0 unresolvable` → exit 0; `--records-json` seeded

- `bash scripts/ci/dep_audit.sh` → before the fix: `Found 12 known vulnerabilities in
  starlette 0.48.0`; after `fastapi>=0.141,<0.142` + `starlette>=1.3.1` (resolved to
  1.6.0): `No known vulnerabilities found`, exit 0.
- First on-runner run surfaced **pre-existing `web/package-lock.json` drift** (npm 10 on
  the runner: "Missing: @emnapi/runtime@1.11.3 / @emnapi/core@1.11.3 / @types/node@26.5.1"
  — the committed lock's internal ranges were inconsistent; local npm 11 was lenient so
  the drift was invisible locally). Regenerated with `npx npm@10 install --package-lock-only`
  → `npm ci` green under npm 10 (747 pkgs) + `typecheck`/`check:licenses`/`build` green.
- `make docs-check` → exit 0; `bash scripts/docs/check-build-memory.sh .` → exit 0
  (1 pre-existing BM-ADR-04 warning, also present on the clean base — verified via stash);
  `uv run python docs/build/tools/check_spec_src.py` → exit 0 (77 ADRs, byte-identical spec).
- `tests/connectors/test_secrets.py` green; no token literal anywhere (env-only, HG-09).
- **Honesty boundary:** GitHub Actions cannot be executed from this context — the
  workflows are defined and structure-pinned by tests, and every command they run was
